'''Wu Chengkang''' ({{zh|s=吴承康}}; 14 November 1929 – 25 December 2022) was a Chinese engineer, and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://new.qq.com/rain/a/20221226A0355L00 |script-title=zh:悲痛！吴承康院士逝世，为我国著名高温气体动力学家 |work=qq.com |date=30 December 2022 |access-date=26 December 2022 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
Wu was born in [[Shanghai]], on 14 November 1929. He attended [[Nanyang Model High School]]. In 1947, he entered Jiaotong University, where he majored in the Department of Mechanical Engineering. After completing his master's degree from the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]] in 1952, he entered [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] where he obtained his doctor's degree in 1957.<ref>[https://chinavitae.com/biography/Wu_Chengkang "Wu Chengkang"], ''China Vitae website'' at chinavitae.com. Retrieved 18 August 2023.</ref>

Wu returned to China in 1957 and became associate research fellow of the Power Research Office of Chinese Academy of Sciences. In 1970, he was transferred to the 7th Ministry of Machinery Industry, serving until 1978. Since 1978, he successively worked as associate researcher, researcher, director of the Research Room.

On 25 December 2022, Wu died in [[Beijing]], at the age of 93.<ref>{{cite news|author1=Zhu Zixia ({{lang|zh|朱子峡}}) |url=https://www.sogou.com/web?query=%E5%90%B4%E6%89%BF%E5%BA%B7%E9%99%A2%E5%A3%AB%E9%80%9D%E4%B8%96%EF%BC%8C%E4%B8%BA%E6%88%91%E5%9B%BD%E8%91%97%E5%90%8D%E9%AB%98%E6%B8%A9%E6%B0%94%E4%BD%93%E5%8A%A8%E5%8A%9B%E5%AD%A6%E5%AE%B6&_asf=www.sogou.com&_ast=&w=01019900&p=40040100&ie=utf8&from=index-nologin&s_from=index&sut=197&sst0=1672056457367&lkt=0%2C0%2C0&sugsuv=1665918010679531&sugtime=1672056457367 |script-title=zh:5天痛失13位院士，12月以来各行各业讣告不断，这些名人离我们而去 |work=Sohu |date=22 December 2022 |access-date=26 December 2022 |language=zh}}</ref>
